gist.summary: The daily automated update refreshed app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json. It changes catalog tracking data, not app functionality.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, a retro terminal displays app request and repository counts beside a code-plant, with a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, chunky sprites, and retro gaming vibes. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small within the scene and wearing tiny reading glasses, she checks the numbers on a clipboard in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic.
